context.user_intent: Fix timing vulnerability in API authentication bearer token verification
context.decision_rationale: Direct string comparison in verify_token exposes a timing side-channel attack vector. We must migrate to hmac.compare_digest for constant-time evaluation.
context.discussion_summary: Identified potential timing leak when comparing authorization tokens. Decided to patch security.py with constant-time HMAC comparison.

task.title: Fix timing attack in Bearer token authentication
task.description: Refactor token comparison logic in security module to strictly utilize hmac.compare_digest. Ensure handling of None and empty inputs without throwing unhandled exceptions.

file_operations.description: Verify presence of verify_token and hmac.compare_digest implementation

automated_checks.name: Verify constant-time HMAC comparison execution
automated_checks.command: python3 -c "import hmac; from bridge.security import verify_token; assert verify_token('secret-123', 'secret-123') is True; assert verify_token('wrong', 'secret-123') is False; assert verify_token(None, 'secret-123') is False"

manual_verification_steps: Submit valid token request to /api/tasks and check 201 Created response
Submit invalid token request to /api/tasks and check 401 Unauthorized response
verification.acceptance_statement: Bearer token comparison executes in constant time using hmac.compare_digest and passes all unit assertions.
